name: RegionalConnect
summary: Regional QLD ISP ('formerly CairnsNet/AussieWide/GetOnIt'); took over the getonit.com.au domain from Feb 2011 (operated by PLANET OZI PTY LTD, ACN 108 139 037).

events.details: Later wound down. Regional Connect kept retailing until 2017 on its home subdomain and was folded into Planet Ozi branding by Sep 2017 - 2012 (prop) and c. 2015 (current) are both wrong.

refs.label: After www 302'd to home.regionalconnect.com.au in Oct 2012, the full Regional Connect retail site (ADSL2+/NBN/VoIP) ran there through 2014 and into 2017.
By Sep 2017 the homepage served Planet Ozi - the ispX umbrella consolidation that also replaced starwon.com.au in Sep 2017.
The Oct 2012 event was a move to the home subdomain, not a closure.
ABR: PLANET OZI PTY LTD (T/AS REGIONAL INTERNET CONNECT) ACN 108 139 037
